claims.text: The GitHub Copilot cloud agent runs in an ephemeral environment protected by a firewall, and the firewall is enabled by default.
The Copilot cloud agent can only push to a single branch, which is either the existing pull request branch or a new branch prefixed with copilot/.
Actions workflows on pull requests created by the Copilot cloud agent require approval from a user with write access before they run.
The Copilot cloud agent has no access to organization or repository secrets, except those added to the copilot environment.
The Copilot cloud agent scans new code it writes using CodeQL, secret scanning and dependency analysis.
The Copilot cloud agent environment is subject to automated security scanning.
GitHub announced Agent HQ on October 28, 2025.
Agent HQ includes mission control, which lets users assign, steer and track agents from multiple vendors.
Agent HQ includes an agent control plane that provides policies, audit logging and controls over which agents are allowed.
